goal: Reschedule an existing Annual Health Checkup appointment to a new date
constraints: Use testdata values. Appointment date must be at least 5 days from today. Use plausible Indian names, cities, phone numbers.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
Test account must have an existing AHC appointment booked

phases.description: State intent to modify/reschedule the annual health checkup
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented Reschedule and Cancel options for the existing booking

phases.description: Choose reschedule and provide new date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the new date and asked whether to change location

phases.description: Confirm location change and provide new state/city
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented clinic options for the new city

phases.description: Click Select on a clinic to confirm reschedule
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment has been rescheduled

name: AHC reschedule existing booking
